closures: Reviewer envelopes now retain normalized GitHub transport receipts whose source ID, repository URL, event type, timestamp, body hash, fetched commit and envelope hash are validated; the authorized connector remains the authentication boundary.
Every G00-G17 and negative-control result now uses a distinct typed execution receipt whose gate-specific checker and every input/output resolve to exact source/evidence bindings.
G00-G15 and ordered reviews produce PREPACKAGE_ACCEPTED; staged packaging performs G16 clean extraction and G17 detached attestation before final publication.
The ZIP, digest and full G17 attestation are staged together and exposed only by one directory rename; postcheck or attestation-write failure leaves no final bundle.
Public protocol and machine schema use the same field names and status vocabulary.
limitations: The standard-library controller cannot cryptographically authenticate GitHub; the authorized connector verifies live events before normalization.
Typed receipts enforce structure, binding and checker identity, while domain-specific checker correctness remains an independent review responsibility.
Notification deduplication and repeated-blocker escalation remain outer-coordinator responsibilities.
Physical S1, continuous braid proof, cutoff convergence and the composed physical budget remain out of scope.
